name: ichinya/laratesto-rector
description: Rector rules to migrate Laravel PHPUnit test suites to Laratesto.

suggest.ichinya/laratesto: The Laratesto runtime API these rules rewrite to. Requires the release that ships the multi-connection database attributes (connections/tables/exceptTables on DatabaseTruncation and RefreshDatabase); use dev-main until that release — the rules do NOT produce code compatible with runtime 0.6.9.
